name: HedgePay staking forceExit pays out the stake without clearing the staked balance
summary: The HedgePay HPAY staking proxy's implementation lets any staker call forceExit() to receive its full staked balance, but forceExit never decreases that balance or totalSupply, so the same stake can be withdrawn again. On 2025-12-22 a staker account paid out once through forceExit and again through withdraw eight blocks later; on 2026-02-25 an attacker staked 1.17M flash-borrowed HPAY and called forceExit 50 times, draining 57.5M HPAY of other stakers' deposits and selling it for 26.01 BNB.

loss.notes: Gross depletion of the staking proxy's HPAY beyond the exploiting accounts' own stakes. Campaign 1 (2025-12-22, sweeper 0x07eb2a01 operating the EIP-7702-delegated 2022 staker account 0xf2552dd6): forceExit paid 25,475.22865342 HPAY and withdraw then paid 25,475.228653419999999999 HPAY again; only the second payout is counted, valued at the HPAY/BTCB pair spot reserves times the DefiLlama BTCB price (no HPAY feed). Campaign 2 (2026-02-25): proxy HPAY 58,649,389.75968834 -> 1,124,071.708415473546212768, i.e. 50 forceExit payouts of 1,173,986.082679038090893617 minus the attacker's single post-tax stake of the same amount; the attacker sold the proceeds via HPAY/BTCB and BTCB/WBNB for 26.014224201105944931 WBNB, valued at the DefiLlama WBNB price as realised proceeds. HPAY transfer taxes to fee addresses and the flash loan are not netted.

ageReset.description: ProxyAdmin 0x0004b983d1b06fc3539170d75d15bc56875f1ac4 upgrade(proxy, 0xbe189fe9...) emitted the only Upgraded(address) event of the TransparentUpgradeableProxy before the exploit, replacing the constructor implementation 0xcd4b1ea3535dd37130c1bb2df42ee61a024b3e8a.

limitations: Implementation 0xbe189fe9 is unverified; the defect is established from execution (payouts and a successful full withdraw after forceExit) and BlockSec's analysis, not from source.

sources.note: Lead: BlockSec (source-12) names staking contract 0xBe189fe9 and tx source-3; 0xbe189fe9 is the implementation behind TransparentUpgradeableProxy 0x6e30c17d2554dca5a1ac178939764c6bf61ab95a (verified proxy source; EIP-1967 slot 0x360894a1...382bbc = 0xcd4b1ea3... at 15401531, 0xbe189fe9 at 15401532, 72548453 and 83268462). source-3 (83268463:1, contract creation by 0x734e1bda): callTracer shows 0x0dc0c0e0 calling proxy stake(uint256) (0xa694fc3a) once and forceExit() (0x67acc704) 50 times, each DELEGATECALL to 0xbe189fe9; receipt HPAY logs: one 1173986082679038090893617 transfer into the proxy (log 8) and 50 transfers of the same amount out (logs 10-59); proxy totalSupply() and HPAY balance both 58649389759688340000000001 at 83268462.
